question_or_proposition: Whether footnote *4's timing language ('first springtime after the permit effective date, during the irrigation season when irrigation return flows in the lower Animas Ditch likely discharge back to the Animas River') establishes mandatory conditions for when the once-per-term Whole Effluent Toxicity monitoring obligation applies, determining whether WET monitoring was required during Federal FY2025.
required_context: Whether irrigation return flows from lower Animas Ditch likely discharged to the Animas River during the relevant irrigation season(s)
Footnote *3 cross-reference to Part II Whole Effluent Toxicity Testing Requirements
notes: Footnote *4 governs timing for report-only WET monitoring (Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas, Once/Term). Resolving when the obligation applies affects monitoring applicability (Purpose B) and how missing WET results should be classified (Purpose C). Purpose A concerns enforceable numeric limits; WET is report-only.
